itb.lod_note: LOD nodes are siblings under the root: show exactly one (camera distance to the root >= switch_m of that LOD and < switch_m of the next). LOD1 / LOD0 share the shell meshes and atlas A; LOD2 is one joined node (L2_itb, extras.parts keeps the per-part tags) with its own atlas B. Phone / far tier: data/buildings3d/itb_lod2.glb holds the LOD2 subtree alone (same root transform).
